school_name: Nebraska Methodist College of Nursing & Allied Health

boards.school_name: Nebraska Methodist College of Nursing & Allied Health
boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Documented Nebraska Methodist College ceremonies, symbols, and recurring student activities tied to healthcare education and campus life.

cards.title: Take the Edna A. Fagan pledge
cards.subtitle: NMC nursing milestone
cards.notes: If you are entering nursing, look for the college’s Edna A. Fagan ceremony and its public affirmation of choosing nursing at NMC.
cards.short_summary: A named NMC nursing ceremony honoring longtime Methodist School of Nursing leader Edna Fagan.
cards.evidence_claim: NMC identifies the Edna Fagan Pledging Ceremony as an occasion where baccalaureate nursing students publicly affirm their nursing career choice.
cards.source_title: NMC Nursing Students Take Part In Pledging Ceremony
cards.access_notes: Ceremony participation is program-based; confirm current scheduling with NMC.

cards.title: Hear the student-written nursing pledge
cards.subtitle: Edna A. Fagan Pledging Ceremony
cards.notes: Read the NMC nursing pledge before a ceremony; it was rewritten by NMC students and is used in the college’s pledge-and-pinning event.
cards.short_summary: A nursing pledge written by NMC students and used at the college’s pledge-and-pinning ceremony.
cards.evidence_claim: NMC reports that a trio of its students rewrote the nursing pledge and that their words have since been used in its pledge-and-pinning ceremony.
cards.source_title: Pledge and Pin Represent NMC Students’ Commitment to Nursing
cards.access_notes: This is a program ceremony practice, not a drop-in visitor activity.

cards.title: Mark the milestone with a nursing pin
cards.subtitle: NMC nursing pledge-and-pinning ceremony
cards.notes: For a visual record, use the college’s ceremony coverage to identify the moment students are pinned after taking the NMC nursing pledge.
cards.short_summary: NMC frames pinning as the modern successor to historical nursing capping ceremonies.
cards.evidence_claim: NMC describes its pledging-and-pinning ceremony as a modern version of earlier nursing capping ceremonies.
cards.source_title: Pledge and Pin Represent NMC Students’ Commitment to Nursing
cards.access_notes: Available to eligible nursing students through their program; verify current ceremony details.

cards.entity_name: Nebraska Methodist College Student Nurse Pin
cards.title: Spot the laurel-ringed student nurse pin
cards.subtitle: NMC nursing symbol
cards.notes: Use the college’s ceremony photographs to identify the NMC student nurse pin: its emblem is surrounded by laurel leaves.
cards.short_summary: A school-specific nursing pin that identifies NMC as the student’s institution of learning.
cards.evidence_claim: NMC says the pin given to nursing students displays the Nebraska Methodist logo surrounded by laurel leaves.
cards.source_title: NMC Nursing Students Take Part In Pledging Ceremony
cards.access_notes: Presented within the nursing program’s pledging tradition.

cards.title: Find the heart-and-dove pledge pin
cards.subtitle: NMC nursing progression marker
cards.notes: Look for the heart-and-dove pin in the college’s pinning coverage; an alum describes wearing it with later nursing certificate pins.
cards.short_summary: A named NMC pledge pin associated with a student’s progression in nursing.
cards.evidence_claim: NMC’s coverage identifies a heart-and-dove student nurse pledge pin worn by an NMC alum alongside nursing certificate pins.
cards.source_title: Pledge and Pin Represent NMC Students’ Commitment to Nursing
cards.access_notes: A program-associated symbol; availability and presentation practices may vary.

cards.title: Begin OT with a professionalism ceremony
cards.subtitle: NMC occupational therapy
cards.notes: Ask the occupational therapy program whether its professionalism ceremony is scheduled for your cohort; NMC documented it as a planned longstanding tradition.
cards.short_summary: An NMC occupational therapy entry ceremony centered on professional values.
cards.evidence_claim: NMC described its occupational therapy professionalism ceremony as a tradition intended to become longstanding at the college.
cards.source_title: Occupational Therapy Master’s Program Welcomes Students
cards.access_notes: Cohort-specific event; confirm whether the practice remains on the current program calendar.

cards.title: Recite the OT professionalism pledge
cards.subtitle: NMC occupational therapy
cards.notes: Review the published pledge as a record of the ceremony: it commits students to care, ethics, diversity, and lifelong learning.
cards.short_summary: A school-specific pledge used by NMC occupational therapy students at their professionalism ceremony.
cards.evidence_claim: NMC reports that occupational therapy students recited a professionalism pledge created by Professor Mary Turner.
cards.source_title: Occupational Therapy Master’s Program Welcomes Students
cards.access_notes: Cohort-specific ceremony element; confirm current practice with the program.

cards.title: Receive an OT student pin
cards.subtitle: Occupational Therapy Professionalism Ceremony
cards.notes: The ceremony record shows students lining up to receive OT student pins; use that image trail when documenting this cohort tradition.
cards.short_summary: Pins created for NMC occupational therapy students as part of their professionalism ceremony.
cards.evidence_claim: NMC states that occupational therapy students received student pins at the professionalism ceremony and that the pins were created by Professor Mary Turner.
cards.source_title: Occupational Therapy Master’s Program Welcomes Students
cards.access_notes: Cohort-specific ceremony element; confirm current practice with the program.

cards.title: Cross into the NMC alumni community
cards.subtitle: NMC commencement ceremony
cards.notes: Follow current NMC commencement announcements for the ceremony that recognizes nursing, allied health, and healthcare management graduates.
cards.short_summary: A recurring NMC graduation ceremony that welcomes graduates into the college’s alumni community.
cards.evidence_claim: NMC reported that its December 2024 commencement honored 96 nursing, allied health, and healthcare management graduates.
cards.source_title: 96 NMC graduates receive degrees during fall ceremonies
cards.access_notes: For graduates and invited guests; check NMC’s current commencement information.

cards.title: Join the annual dodgeball tournament
cards.subtitle: NMC campus activity
cards.notes: Check the NMC events calendar or Student Engagement for the current tournament date, format, eligibility, and any needed registration.
cards.short_summary: A recurring campus dodgeball tournament named by NMC as one of its student social activities.
cards.evidence_claim: NMC’s student safety page lists an annual dodgeball tournament among campus activities students participate in.
cards.access_notes: Confirm current date, location, and registration through NMC before attending.

warnings: Several documented ceremony practices are described in older official NMC articles; current scheduling or continuation should be confirmed with the relevant program.
